label: Product quality & accuracy
issues_summary: Customers report declining fabric quality, thin material, poor stitching, and images that don’t match delivered items. Mislabeling of size, fit, and material (e.g., polyester as silk) is common. Wrong or used products are received, and returns are denied or charged a convenience fee. Refunds are partial or deducted to Myntra cash, causing frustration. Overall, quality control and accurate product information are unreliable.

label: Size, fit & availability
issues_summary: Customers report receiving wrong sizes, items marked in stock but unavailable for exchange, limited return options, inconsistent size labeling, and difficulty finding desired sizes. They also note frustration with unhelpful staff and lack of accurate size charts, leading to repeated returns or refunds.

label: Pricing, discounts & value
issues_summary: Customers complain that discounts and coupons often disappear or are not applied, sales are misleading, and high service or convenience fees inflate prices. First‑order benefits are denied, orders get cancelled without explanation, and invoices contain errors leading to partial refunds. Quality is perceived as poor, with polyester items fading quickly, and customers feel overcharged for similar products elsewhere.

label: Wishlist & cart reliability
issues_summary: Customers report that adding items to wishlist or cart triggers price hikes, sudden unavailability, or long stockouts, causing uncertainty and forcing purchases elsewhere. They also face wishlist limits: a 1,000‑item cap, time‑based restrictions, and forced removal of items, which frustrates and discourages use.

label: Delivery, returns & refunds
issues_summary: Customers report receiving wrong or damaged items, being forced to reorder and pay platform fees, and facing high convenience fees after multiple returns. Pickup failures, delayed or denied refunds, and unresponsive support create uncertainty. Delivery is often late or incorrectly marked as failed, preventing returns. Gift‑wrapping fees are non‑refundable, and customers are blacklisted for normal returns.

label: Support, payment & app experience
issues_summary: Customers report delayed or missing deliveries, refunds credited to wrong accounts, unresponsive support that repeats generic answers, difficulty with returns, extra charges, poor product quality, lack of dark mode, and excessive packaging waste.
